fr_html: M. ALTAMIRA donnera un vote contraire, bien que quelques-unes des objections qu'il a soulevées contre l'article soient disparues.
en_html: M. ALTAMIRA opposed the adoption of the Article, although some of the objections he had raised against it had now disappeared.
